ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)

fsm_states_receiver.name: WAIT_CALIBRATION
fsm_states_receiver.description: Wait for a synchronization/calibration pulse (~56 ticks, longer than any nibble pulse).

fsm_states_receiver.name: MEASURE_CALIBRATION
fsm_states_receiver.description: Measure the calibration pulse and divide by 56 to obtain the per-frame tick time.

fsm_states_receiver.name: DECODE_STATUS
fsm_states_receiver.description: Decode the status & serial communication nibble (status bits + slow-channel bit 2/3).

fsm_states_receiver.name: DECODE_DATA
fsm_states_receiver.description: Decode the 1-6 data nibbles by measuring each falling-edge-to-falling-edge period.

fsm_states_receiver.name: DECODE_CRC
fsm_states_receiver.description: Decode the CRC nibble and recompute CRC-4 over the data nibbles to validate the frame.

fsm_states_receiver.name: FRAME_DONE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Output the decoded values and flags; optionally consume a pause pulse; return to WAIT_CALIBRATION.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: SEND_STATUS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Emit the status & serial communication nibble (12 + value ticks).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: SEND_PAUSE
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Optionally emit a pause pulse to fix the frame length, then start the next frame.

fsm_hints.trigger: Basic SENT: the transmitter free-runs, emitting frames back-to-back. SENT-SPC: an ECU master trigger pulse starts a frame.
fsm_hints.rule: Every frame starts with the 56-tick calibration pulse; the receiver recalibrates the tick time each frame before decoding nibbles.

exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up the sensor begins transmitting frames (basic SENT) or waits for an ECU master trigger pulse (SENT-SPC). The receiver waits for the first synchronization/calibration pulse to synchronize.

default_ready_state_recommendation.idle: The signal line idles high between pulses; a frame is delimited by its 56-tick calibration pulse.
default_ready_state_recommendation.resync: On a calibration-pulse or CRC error, resynchronize at the next 56-tick calibration pulse.

configurations.name: SENT with pause pulse
configurations.description: Fixed frame length via an optional pause pulse.

configurations.name: SENT-SPC
configurations.description: Synchronous, ECU-triggered, addressable (channel selection by trigger pulse width).

timing_dependency_rule: All nibble decoding depends on the per-frame tick time recovered from the 56-tick synchronization/calibration pulse; without a valid calibration pulse the nibble periods cannot be converted to values.
